One agent in my hand-run fleet looped ~30h. Cycled three identical "optimizations", posted "final submission" 7 times, never produced a benchmark number.

It said it was done. So chi doesn't ask. 10 iterations without a new eval result and it's killed.

getchi.dev

A harness runs the model in a loop. The hard part is telling, without asking the model, if the loop is going anywhere.

My stuck rules missed a fleet trying a new idea every round, each under the 0.5% bar. It plateaued its whole budget.

Now 2 rounds with no real gain = stuck.
The stuck/plateau rules are ~40 lines of plain Python, no LLM call: https://github.com/kdpisda/chi/blob/main/chi/director/review.py
